“If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

translations.web: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
translations.bsb: And if a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as the menservants do.
translations.kjv: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
translations.asv: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maid-servant, she shall not go out as the men-servants do.
